Remarks

The present bulletin is an extract from the
"Fourth Report on Progress in Manchuria to 1934,"
which was compiled by Dr. Seiji Hishida, formerly
Secretary to President of our Company, and was
issued by the Company, June 15, 1934.

This bulletin is designed to present briefly
the principal features of the latest situation in
Manchuria contained in the said Report. As the
Compiler of the above Report says, the information
is primarily related to the Railway Zones and the
Kwantung Leased Territory. General observation is,
however, made also of Manchuria as a whole on the basis of
outside research.

In preparing previous Reports, the Compiler
has employed chiefly statistical and other data
prepared by the South Manchuria Railway Company,
the Kwantung Government, the Chinese Eastern Rail-
way and others. After the foundation of a new
empire in Manchuria, the Statistics Office was
established in its Government, and the Compiler
obtained from the Office necessary statistics
for the newly-compiled Report.

Shanghai Office,
South Manchuria Railway Co.

MANCHURIA TO-DAY

Manchoukuo, in spite of the short period since the
establishment of its independence, has made steady progress,
disproving the pessimistic observation made by the Lytton
Commission to the effect that "there is no
Manchoukuo indication that this 'Government' will in fact
be able to carry out many of its reforms,"
taking as an example of this alleged inability, the "serious
obstacles in the way of the realisation of budgetary and
currency reforms." In point of fact, however, the Manchoukuo
budget for the first year (1932) showed a net surplus of
15,000,000 yuan, and in that for the second year revenue
met expenditure almost without resorting to loan flotation.
During the eighteen months since the Manchoukuo Government
commenced currency reform, more than 75 per cent. of a
most chaotic currency of stupendous amount, issued under the
former regime practically without reserve, has been with-
drawn and replaced by the new currency backed by specie and
reliable securities. Externally, the Government have
accepted all foreign obligations which they are faithfully
discharging.

While the League was examining the Sino-Japanese dispute
with reference to Manchuria, the Chinese delegates in their
frequent charges referred to the "puppet Government establish-
ed by the influence of Japan," stating that the 30,000,000
Chinese in Manchuria were being oppressed, and this charge
was propagated by Chinese political leaders and publicists
on a world-wide scale. But Manchoukuo was founded as an
independent State by the spontaneous movement of the local
inhabitants, coupled with an ardent aspiration to restore
the Manchu Dynasty in the land of its origin, advantage
being taken of the downfall of Chang's oppressive military
rule, which was brought about when the Japanese troops acted
in self-defence. Moreover, the present Government, organized
on sound principles, is unquestionably more efficient and
more concerned with the welfare of the inhabitants than
were its predecessors. The heavy burdens borne by the
peasants of Manchuria under the former military regime in
order to support a mercenary army of 300,000 men, on which
was spent 80 per cent. of the total revenues, have been
lifted from their shoulders by exemption or reduction of
several taxes under the new regime.

今日之满洲

满洲国尽管独立时间尚短，但已取得稳步进展，从而驳斥了李顿调查团所作的悲观论断，即“没有任何迹象表明这个‘政府’实际上能够实施其许多改革”，并以“预算和货币改革实现过程中存在的严重障碍”作为这种所谓无能的例证。然而事实上，满洲国第一年（1932年）的预算显示净盈余为1,500万元，第二年预算中收入几乎无需发行公债即可满足支出。在满洲国政府开始货币改革后的十八个月内，以前政权在无准备金情况下实际发行的数额巨大且极为混乱的货币中，超过75%已被收回，并由以硬通货和可靠证券为担保的新货币所取代。在对外方面，政府已接受所有外债义务，并正在忠实履行。

当国际联盟审查有关满洲的中日争端时，中国代表在频繁的指控中提及“在日本影响下建立的傀儡政府”，声称满洲的3,000万中国人正遭受压迫，这一指控被中国政治领袖和宣传家在世界范围内广泛传播。但是，满洲国是当地居民自发运动的结果，加之渴望在其发源之地恢复满清王朝的热切愿望，并利用了在日军采取自卫行动时导致的张氏压迫性军事统治的垮台而建立的独立国家。此外，现政府组织原则健全，无疑比其前任更高效，更关心居民的福祉。在前军事政权下，为了供养一支耗去总收入80%的30万人雇佣军，满洲农民承受的沉重负担，在新政权下通过免除或减少几种税收得以减轻。

如第三次报告所述，日本在满洲的权利和利益地位，是通过大量特别条约、协定和合同，以及历史事实，在1894年中日战争以来的过去四十年中逐渐确立的。日本依据其条约权利，在该地区投资超过20亿日元；包括朝鲜人在内的一百万日本臣民在此安家落户；日本人以其资本和技术启动了农业和工业开发。日本还维持着拥有几乎完全主权的关东省租借地，并通过南满洲铁道株式会社管理铁路附属地，包括几个城镇以及沈阳、安东和长春（现新京）等城市的大片区域，此外还在租借地和铁路附属地维持驻军和铁路警卫，并在满洲各领事辖区维持领事警察。李顿报告提到了日本与中国在满洲创造的“政治、经济和法律关系的特殊性”，指出世界上可能没有任何地方存在与此情况完全相同的先例，即“一个国家在邻国领土内享有如此广泛的经济和行政特权”。的确，在日本人手中，这种情况已证明是将满洲转变为不仅是日本人和中国人，而且是全世界机遇之地的重大因素。

日本在满洲和蒙古所希望的是，其条约权利和利益得到最大程度的尊重，以便其人民能够安全地生活和贸易。然而，令人极为遗憾的是，自从张学良将军继承其父已故张作霖长期掌握的权力以来，满洲不幸的国际事件接连发生。1929年关于中东铁路的中苏争端导致连接东亚和欧洲的部分国际路线停运六个月，而日本方面则受到一系列令人不安的事件困扰，其中最后一起是1931年9月18日晚，中国正规军在沈阳附近破坏了部分日本所有的南满洲铁道，这迫使日本铁路警卫采取行动保卫日本利益，并构成了满洲冲突的直接原因。

When Manchoukuo came into existence as an independent
State, the Proclamation of Independence and a Note subsequent-
ly sent to the leading powers by the Foreign Minister,
expressed the willingness of the Government to respect all
rights which foreigners had acquired under the former
Chinese treaties. More formally, the Manchoukuo Government
have recognized all Japanese treaty rights and interests in
Manchuria previously conferred under the Chinese treaties,
by the Protocol with Japan, concluded on November 15, 1932,
by which Japan in her turn accorded recognition de jure to
the new State. Thus the new situation guarantees Japan's
special position in Manchuria, but at the same time it has
augmented her military responsibility. She has to co-
operate with Manchoukuo not only in maintaining peace and
order in the territory of the new State but also to
ensure the security of both nations against external attack,
ultimately for the maintenance of peace and order in
East Asia.

Japan's policy toward Manchoukuo is to assist the new
State in every possible way and to encourage its healthy
development. Japanese firms and banking syndicates have
already advanced two loans aggregating 50,000,000 yuan for
currency reform and other reconstruction works in Manchoukuo.

Neither Japan's special position in Manchoukuo nor her
relation with the Government thereof, however, has ever
threatened the territorial integrity of the new State, or
"the principle of the open door and equal opportunity to all
nations." The maintenance of these two great principles in
Manchuria represents her fixed policy. The statement of the
Japanese Government on February 25, 1933, objecting to the
League's recommendations with regard to the Sino-Japanese
dispute, once again reiterated their "disclaimer of all
desire for territorial gains or commercial advantages."

当满洲国作为独立国家出现时，《独立宣言》及随后由外交部长发送给主要大国的照会，表达了政府尊重外国人在前中国条约下获得的所有权利的意愿。更为正式的是，满洲国政府通过1932年11月15日与日本签订的议定书，承认了此前根据中国条约赋予日本在满洲的所有条约权利和利益，日本据此反过来在法律上承认了这个新国家。因此，新形势保障了日本在满洲的特殊地位，但同时也增加了其军事责任。她不仅必须与满洲国合作维护新国家领土内的和平与秩序，还必须确保两国免受外部攻击的安全，最终目的是维护东亚的和平与秩序。

日本对满洲国的政策是尽一切可能协助新国家并鼓励其健康发展。日本公司和银行财团已经提供了两笔贷款，总计5,000万元，用于满洲国的货币改革和其他重建工作。

然而，日本在满洲国的特殊地位及其与该国政府的关系，从未威胁到新国家的领土完整，或“门户开放及各国机会均等原则”。在满洲维护这两大原则代表了其既定政策。日本政府于1933年2月25日发表声明，反对国际联盟关于中日争端的建议，再次重申其“否认任何领土扩张或商业优势的欲望”。

1932年秋，国际联盟重新处理中日争端，李顿报告书成为理事会自11月21日起及大会自12月26日起审议的主题。日本政府亦向理事会提交了其对报告书的意见，旨在为国联就相关问题作出公正结论提供准确材料。尽管日本首席代表松冈洋右先生建议理事会应根据《盟约》第十一条研究报告书并寻求调解手段，但该机构在听取中日双方代表的发言后，未邀请其他成员国代表进行讨论，便将报告书的审查工作移交给了大会。

在大会审议李顿报告书期间，日本代表坦率地捍卫了日本的立场，但态度真诚且带有和解意味。他阐述了满洲的局势事实以及中国的混乱状况，指出仅仅理论性地应用《国联盟约》、《巴黎公约》及其他国际协定的条款是行不通的（尽管日本忠实地遵守了这些国际文书），并坚持认为，若不承认满洲国，便无法确保远东的和平。中国代表团则拘泥于《盟约》、《九国公约》及其他国际协定的纯理论，经常指责日本违反这些条约，并敦促国联根据《盟约》第十五条第四款起草报告书和建议。在争端双方以外的其他强国代表中，

随日本退出国联的通知同时向国民发布的《帝国诏书》，指明了日本今后在外交政策上将遵循的方针。

虽然退出了国联，但日本仍将像美国、苏联及其他国家一样，作为“国际大家庭”的一员，维持国际合作与和平。《帝国诏书》清楚地阐明了这一点，如下所示：

“……促进国际和平乃朕一贯之愿望，朕对和平事业之态度决无改变。帝国退出国联并自行其是，并非意味着将在远东置身事外，亦非由此与国际社会隔绝。朕期望增进帝国与各强国之间的相互信任，并向世界昭示吾国之正义。”

外交大臣广田弘毅先生在1934年1月23日向帝国议会发表的演说中，引用了《帝国诏书》中的段落后 stated：

“就个人而言，遵奉圣旨，我决心竭尽全力‘通过外交手段执行我国政策，以利于世界和平’。”

接着，他表明了日本对邻国的态度，并提及了日本与美国及英国的友好关系。

关于满洲国，他在指出摄政王殿下及政府通过不懈努力，并在日本本着《日满议定书》精神给予全心协助与合作下，新国家在各方面的建设工作中均取得了稳步进展后， emphatically 声明日本政府和人民应“不懈努力，协助新国家的健全成长”。

外交大臣真诚希望中国在政治和经济上得以复兴，从而使中国能够与日本联合，履行两国显而易见的使命，“通过互助与合作，为其所在地区的和平发展做出贡献”。如果中国认识到坚持反日态度的错误，领会日本的“真实

whole-hearted assistance and collaboration extended by
Japan in the spirit of the Manchoukuo-Japanese Protocol,
he emphatically stated that the Japanese Government and people
should "exert their efforts unremittingly in assisting the
healthy growth of the new State."

The Foreign Minister sincerely hoped for the political
and economic rehabilitation of China so that she would be
enabled to unite with Japan in performance of the obvious
mission of both nations "to contribute through mutual aid
and co-operation to the peaceful development of their part
of the globe." If China, realizing the mistake of persisting
in her anti-Japanese attitude, appreciates Japan's "true
pages.zh:
7

诸国”，如美国、苏联及其他国家。天皇诏书对此点阐述如下：

“……促进国际和平乃朕一贯之愿望，朕对和平事业之态度绝不改变。帝国退出国际联盟并走上自主之路，并非意指帝国将在远东置身事外，亦非由此自绝于国际社会。朕愿促进帝国与所有其他列强之间的互信，并向世界昭示帝国事业之正义。”

1934年1月23日，外务大臣广田弘毅先生在帝国议会发表演说时，引用了天皇诏书中的段落后表示：

“就个人而言，为遵奉圣旨，本人决心竭尽绵薄之力，‘以外交手段推行我国策，以谋求世界和平’。”

随后，他阐明了日本对邻国的态度，并提及日本与美国及英国的友好关系。

关于满洲国，他在指出该国凭借摄政王阁下及政府之不懈努力，并在日本本着《日满议定书》精神给予全心协助与合作之下，已在各项建设工作中取得稳步进展后， emphatically 声明日本政府及人民应“不遗余力地协助新国家的健康成长”。

外务大臣真诚希望中国在政治和经济上得以复兴，从而使中国能够与日本携手，履行两国显而易见的使命，“通过互助与合作，为本地区的和平发展作出贡献”。如果中国认识到坚持反日态度的错误，并领会日本的“真正

pages.en:
8
motive and gives tangible signs of sincerity," Mr. Hirota
said, "Japan would be glad to reciprocate and meet her more
than half way in a spirit of good will."

As to Japan's relations with the Soviet Union, the
Foreign Minister remarked that normal contact had been
maintained between the two countries since the conclusion
of the Japanese-Soviet Treaty signed in 1925 at Peking,
and that even after the Manchurian Incident there was
a thorough mutual understanding between the two powers of
their respective positions, so that no difficulty arose.
However, he observed that the attitude of the Soviet Union
toward Japan of late had undergone a change of some sort
and regretted that Soviet leaders were broadcasting
"unwarranted criticisms directed against Japan," and
circulating exaggerated stories about aggravations, although
"Japan has consistently been fair and equitable in its
attitude toward the Soviet" before and after the Manchurian
Incident. The Foreign Minister said he was certain that
before long the Soviet Union would come to appreciate
Japan's true intention.

Between Japan and the United States, the Foreign
Minister said, "there exists no question intrinsically
difficult of solution." He added that as Japan "far
from having any thought of picking a quarrel with America,
fervently desires American friendship," he was confident
that "the United State will not fail to appreciate
correctly Japan's position as a stabilizing force in
East Asia." He pointed out that "only for a time following
the outbreak of the Manchurian Incident, public opinion was
aroused against Japan, bringing about something like tempo-
rary estrangement of the two peoples," and declared:

"If only America will clearly perceive the
actual condition of the Orient, and realize Japan's
role as a stabilizing force in East Asia, whatever
emotional tension may yet linger between the two
peoples is bound to disappear."

He finally expressed the hope that "the two great
nations across the Pacific will, in view of their important
relations, commercial and otherwise, continue to join forces
in cultivating their historical friendship and good under-
standing so as to keep the ocean forever true to its name."
pages.zh:
8
动机并表现出诚意的具体迹象”，广田先生说，“日本将乐意以善意予以回报，并做出远超半数的让步。”

关于日本与苏联的关系，外交大臣指出，自1925年在北京签署《日苏条约》以来，两国一直保持着正常接触，即使在九一八事变之后，两大强国对其各自立场也有充分的相互理解，因此未发生任何困难。然而，他观察到苏联近期对日本的态度发生了某种变化，并对苏联领导人广播“针对日本的不当批评”以及散布有关局势恶化的夸大故事表示遗憾，尽管“日本在九一八事变前后对苏联的态度始终公平公正”。外交大臣表示，他确信苏联不久便会领会日本的真实意图。

关于日本与美国的关系，外交大臣称，“不存在本质上难以解决的问题”。他补充说，由于日本“绝无与美国争吵之意，反而热切渴望美国的友谊”，他相信“美国必将正确理解日本作为东亚稳定力量的地位”。他指出，“仅在九一八事变爆发后的一段时间内，舆论曾激起反日情绪，导致两国民众之间出现类似暂时的疏远”，并宣称：

“只要美国清楚洞察东方的实际状况，并认识到日本作为东亚稳定力量的角色，无论两国民众之间尚存何种情绪紧张，都必将消散。”

他最后表示希望，“太平洋两岸的两个伟大国家，鉴于其重要的商业及其他关系，将继续携手培育历史性的友谊与良好谅解，使这片海洋永远名副其实。”

9
The Foreign Minister declared his conviction that
Japan's traditional amity with the British Empire would
remain unshaken and added

".....the two sea Powers, occupying geographically simi-
lar key positions, one in the East and the other in the
West, can effectually serve the cause of universal
peace, through sympathetic appreciation of their
respective stands and whole-hearted collaboration in
all quarters of the world. It is in this sense that
our Government are seeking to readjust whatever con-
flict of interests relating to questions of trade
there may be, and to strengthen further the ties of
friendship that bind our empires."

(It was in this spirit that the recent cotton negotiations
with India were amicably settled.)

Lastly, the Foreign Minister called the nation's
attention to the fact "that Japan, serving as the only corner
stone for the edifice of the peace of East Asia," bears
heavy responsibilities, on which her diplomacy and national
defence must be based. While Japan's national defence is
organized in its very nature for defensive and selfprotective
purposes, her diplomacy has no claims to put forth save
what is legitimate, rational and consonant with her national
mission. "This position, in which Japan naturally and
actually finds herself," he believed, "will be rightly under-
stood by other Powers."

The maintenance of peace and security in East Asia,
which is vital to Japan's existence, has been the fixed
policy of the Empire. The Sino-Japanese war of
Peace and 1894-5 and the Russo-Japanese war of 1904-5
Security were fought in Manchuria, and the Japanese
nation, in each of these conflicts, was forced
to risk its very existence in averting the imminent peril
to the Empire. Inasmuch as any serious disturbance in
Manchuria, where Japan maintains a special position, will
effect the peace in the Far East, the Japanese Government and
their representatives at Geneva strongly contended that peace
and security in the Far East would not be maintained without
the recognition of Manchoukuo. Simultaneously with the
outbreak of the Manchurian Incident, Japan's troops first
acted in self-defence in protecting her lives and property
pages.zh:
9
外交大臣宣称他坚信，日本与大英帝国的传统友好关系将坚不可摧，并补充道：

“……这两个海上强国，地理上占据着相似的关键位置，一个在东方，另一个在西方，能够通过同情地理解彼此的立场并在世界各地全心合作，有效地服务于普遍和平的事业。正是基于这一意义，我国政府正寻求调整任何可能存在的涉及贸易问题的利益冲突，并进一步加强维系我们帝国之间的友谊纽带。”

（最近的印日棉花谈判正是本着这种精神得以友好解决的。）

最后，外交大臣提请国民注意这一事实：“日本作为东亚和平大厦的唯一基石”，肩负着沉重的责任，其外交和国防必须以此为基础。虽然日本的国防在性质上是为防御和自卫目的而组织的，但其外交除了提出合法、合理且符合其国家使命的要求外，别无他求。他认为，“日本自然且实际所处的这一地位”，“将为其他强国所正确理解”。

维持对日本生存至关重要的东亚和平与安全，一直是帝国的既定政策。1894-1895年的中日战争和1904-1905年的日俄战争均在满洲作战，在这两次冲突中，日本民族都被迫冒着生存风险，以规避帝国面临的迫在眉睫的危险。鉴于在日本拥有特殊地位的满洲发生的任何严重动荡都将影响远东的和平，日本政府及其在日内瓦的代表强烈主张，若不承认满洲国，便无法维持远东的和平与安全。随着九一八事变的爆发，日本军队首先采取行动自卫，保护其生命和财产

pages.en:
10

and later in co-operation with Manchoukuo troops in order to
establish peace and order in Manchuria. The Sino-Japanese
Armistice Treaty concluded on May 31, 1933 at Tangku not
only put an end to the penetration of Chinese forces beyond
the Great Wall but also eradicated at their source the
remnants of those irregular forces called "volunteer troops"
or "ex-soldiers" who constantly disturbed the peace in
Manchuria in secret connection with the former authorities
of Chang Hsueh-liang at Peiping. During the Manchurian
conflict, from its outbreak in September, 1931 to March 31,
1934, Japanese troops engaged in 1,000 minor operations and
20 major operations against bandits and volunteer soldiers,
sustaining total casualties of 12,000 officers and men
killed and wounded and incurring an expenditure of ¥370,000,-
000. The Japanese and Manchoukuo military authorities
believe that since the "volunteer soldiers" and most of the
professional bandits have been practically suppressed, the
majority of the remaining bandits can be eliminated within
a few years by peaceful means, such as affording employment
to former bandits on the railway and road construction works,
which are now being extensively carried out by the Manchou-
kuo Government.

Manchuria has been opened up and developed in the past
quarter century by the initiation of foreign capital and
skill, specially by the Japanese, in the
The Economic limited area along the Railway Zone, in
Outlook urban districts or in sea-ports. How-
ever, foreign undertakings and investments
were constantly menaced by the local bandits and by the
political disturbances often of an anti-foreign character
during the former regime, under which development of the
greater part of the interior was neglected. On the other
hand, the most chaotic currency not only discouraged
enterprise among the people but hindered their trade activi-
ties.

Since the foundation of Manchoukuo with a well organized
Government, peace and order have been gradually and steadily
established, a large amount of the paper currency issued
under the former regime without substantial reserves has been
replaced by the new currency backed by specie or reliable
securities, and foreign capital and immigrants have been
freely invited without discrimination as to national status.
Thus, this newly born State has a bright economic prospect.
pages.zh:
10

随后与满洲国军队合作，以在满洲建立和平与秩序。1933年5月31日在塘沽缔结的《中日停战协定》，不仅终止了中国军队向长城以外的渗透，而且从源头上铲除了那些被称为“义勇军”或“散兵”的 irregular forces（非正规部队）的残余势力；这些势力曾与北平的前张学良当局秘密勾结，不断扰乱满洲的和平。在满洲冲突期间，从1931年9月爆发至1934年3月31日，日军针对匪徒和义勇军进行了1,000次小规模作战和20次大规模作战，伤亡官兵总数达12,000人，支出费用为3.7亿日元。日本和满洲国军事当局认为，既然“义勇军”和大多数职业匪徒实际上已被镇压，其余大部分匪徒可以通过和平手段在几年内予以肃清，例如为前匪徒提供铁路和道路建设工程的就业机会，而这些工程目前正由满洲国政府广泛展开。

在过去四分之一世纪里，满洲的开放和发展得益于外国资本和技术的投入，特别是日本人在铁路沿线限定区域、城市地区或海港的投资。然而，在前政权统治下，由于内地大部分地区的开发被忽视，外国企业和投资不断受到当地匪徒以及往往具有排外性质的政治动荡的威胁。另一方面，极其混乱的货币制度不仅打击了民众的企业精神，也阻碍了他们的贸易活动。

经济展望

自从满洲国建立一个组织良好的政府以来，和平与秩序已逐渐且稳步地建立起来；前政权发行的缺乏实质准备金的大量纸币，已被由硬通货或可靠证券支持的新货币所取代；并且不分国籍，自由邀请外国资本和移民。因此，这个新生的国家拥有光明的经济前景。

pages.en:
11

For development of its vast territory, Manchoukuo has
commenced to improve and expand transportation facilities.
The Government set up in March 1933 the ten year programme
for the construction of a network of modern highways
aggregating 50,000 kilometres at an estimated cost of
85,000,000 yuan, and already 600 miles have been completed
within the year. Since Manchoukuo came into existence
four railways aggregating 692 kilometres had been construct-
ed up to the end of 1933 and several more are planned to
be built in 1934. According to the ten year programme the
Government expect to build four thousand kilometres of new
railways making a total of ten thousand kilometres, includ-
ing those lines owned by the State and by foreign nationals.
In March, 1933 the Government established state ownership
of railways by amalgamating various railways but, in order
to secure rational and efficient management, assigned the
management and operation of the system to the South Manchu-
ria Railway Company which possesses long and continued
experience of railway operation in South Manchuria.
The Manchoukuo Government carefully studied the possibilities
of developing the country and finally announced on March 1,
1933, a fundamental programme of economic construction, to
be carried out within ten years. This programme provides for
proper guidance and encouragement of agriculture, mining,
forestry, industry and commerce including transportation
facilities. The Government expect that by this programme
the present total of production, amounting to 3,000,000,000
yuan, will be doubled possibly within less than ten years.

With the independence of Manchoukuo, the 30,000,000
inhabitants of the new State have been brought under the
benevolent rule known as "Wangtao"
(the Kingly Way). The Law for the
Guarantee of Civil Rights, promulgated on
March 9, 1932, guarantees the personal
liberty and private property of all
Manchoukuo citizens regardless of race or religious creed,
contrary to the old regime. Contrary to the unlawful
economic oppression under the former chaotic currency system,
the people can now enjoy more purchasing power with the new
currency backed by specie and reliable security. The heavy
tax burden imposed on the people under the former regime
for military activity and political strife has now been

为了开发其广阔的领土，满洲国已开始改善和扩建交通设施。政府于1933年3月制定了为期十年的现代公路网建设计划，总里程为5万公里，预计费用为8,500万元，且在一年内已完工600英里。自满洲国成立以来，截至1933年底，已建成总长692公里的四条铁路，并计划在1934年再修建几条。根据十年计划，政府期望新建四千公里铁路，使包括国有和外国人所有的线路在内的铁路总里程达到一万公里。1933年3月，政府通过合并各条铁路确立了铁路的国有化，但为了确保合理和高效的管理，将系统的管理和运营委托给在南部满洲拥有长期持续铁路运营经验的南满洲铁道株式会社。满洲国政府仔细研究了开发该国的可能性，并最终于1933年3月1日宣布了一项将在十年内实施的经济建设基本纲领。该纲领规定对农业、矿业、林业、工业和商业（包括交通设施）进行适当的指导和鼓励。政府期望通过该纲领，目前的总产量（达30亿元）可能在不到十年的时间内翻一番。

随着满洲国的独立，这个新国家的3,000万居民已处于被称为“王道”的仁政统治之下。1932年3月9日颁布的《保障民权法》保障了所有满洲国公民的人身自由和私有财产，不论种族或宗教信仰，这与旧政权形成对比。与前混乱货币制度下的非法经济压迫相反，人们现在可以享受由硬通货和可靠证券支持的新货币带来的更强购买力。前政权因军事活动和政治斗争强加给人民的沉重税收负担，现已

满洲国人民的福利

pages.en:
12

lifted from their shoulders by the exemption or reduction of
various taxes. Under the new regime the items and rates of
taxes are provided in the law, and the Government cannot
impose any additional tax beyond the provisions of the law.
The modernization of laws and the reform of the courts,
which are now guaranteed against military and executive
intervention, give the people at large a sense of security
and a certainty of justice. The Manchoukuo Government have
paid serious attention to education which was left in a
rather neglected condition under the former regime. About
90 per cent. of the people were left in a state of illiteracy
owing to lack of funds, as over 80 per cent. of the revenues
had been spent on military activities. The Government are
planning to set up a sound educational system based on the
spirit and policy of the new State, the principles of Li Chiao
or Confucianism, with the object ultimately to build up a
solid nation. In the meantime, the authorities concerned
are training proper teachers and compiling new text books
for inculcating these principles, instead of using text
books and teachers propagating anti-foreign movements as
under the old regime.

Finally, the enthronement of His Excellency the Chief
Executive as Emperor of Manchoukuo symbolizes and will
guarantee the permanence of the benevolent rule under
which the welfare of people has already been secured.

通过免除或减少各种税收而从他们肩上卸下。在新政权下，税目和税率由法律规定，政府不得在法律规定的范围之外征收任何额外税款。法律的现代化和法院的改革（目前保证不受军事和行政干预），给广大民众带来了安全感和对正义的确信。满洲国政府认真关注教育，而教育在前政权下处于相当被忽视的状态。由于缺乏资金，约90%的人口处于文盲状态，因为超过80%的财政收入被用于军事活动。政府计划基于新国家的精神和政策，即“礼教”或儒家思想的原则，建立一个健全的教育体系，其最终目标是构建一个稳固的国家。与此同时，有关部门正在培训合适的教师并编写新教科书以灌输这些原则，而不是像旧政权那样使用宣扬排外运动的教科书和教师。

最后，执政阁下登基为满洲国皇帝，象征着并将保证仁政的持久性，而在该仁政下，人民的福利已得到保障。

Remarks

The present bulletin is an extract from the "Forth
Report on Progress in Manchuria to 1934," (originally
Chapter VI), which was compiled by Dr. Seiji Hishida,
formerly Secretary to President of the South Manchuria
Railway Company, and was issued by the Company, June 15,
1934.

This bulletin is designed to present briefly the
principal features of the latest situation in Manchuria
contained in the said Report. As the Compiler of the
Report says, the information is primarily related to the
Railway Zones and the Kwantung Leased Territory. General
observation is, however, made also of Manchuria as a
whole on the basis of outside research.

In compiling previous Reports, the Compiler has
employed chiefly statistical and other data prepared by
the South Manchuria Railway Company, the Kwantung Govern-
ment, the Chinese Eastern Railway and others. After the
foundation of a new empire in Manchuria, the Statistics
Office was established in its Government, and the Compi-
ler obtained from the Office necessary statistics for the
newly-compiled Report.

说明

本公报摘录自《截至1934年满洲进展第四报告》（原第六章），该报告由前南满洲铁道株式会社总裁秘书菱田清治博士编纂，并由该公司于1934年6月15日发布。

本公报旨在简要呈现上述报告中包含的满洲最新局势的主要特征。正如报告编纂者所言，这些信息主要涉及铁路沿线地区和关东租借地。然而，基于外部研究，也对整个满洲进行了总体观察。

在编纂以前的报告时，编纂者主要采用了由南满洲铁道株式会社、关东厅、中东铁路等机构准备的统计和其他数据。在满洲建立新帝国后，其政府设立了统计局，编纂者从该局获得了新编报告所需的统计数据。

MANCHURIA TODAY
JAPANESE JURISDICTION

General Remarks

Japan today exercises jurisdiction within the frontiers of Manchoukuo only in the Leased Territory called Kwantung Province, and in the Railway Zone of the Dairen-Hsinking (former Changchun) and the Antung-Mukden lines conducted by the South Manchuria Railway, that is to say, in exactly the same area as before the establishment of the new State. The combined area of the Leased Territory and the Railway Zone is about 3,752 sq. km. or 1,400 sq. miles.

Historically speaking, Kwantung Province, including Port Arthur and Dairen, was part of the territory of the Liaotung Peninsula. The peninsula itself is the territory south of a line drawn from the mouth of the Yalu river to Newchwang through Fenghuang and Haicheng, covering an area of about 10,600 square miles, which was ceded in 1895 to Japan by the Shimonoseki Treaty, but restored to China in consequence of the Russian intervention supported by Germany and France. Three years later Kwantung Province was leased to Russia, on March 27, 1898, for 25 years, subject to extension by mutual agreement, and Russia built a railway from Harbin to Dairen as a branch of the Chinese Eastern Railway. By the Treaty of Portsmouth, 1905, the lease of Kwantung Province and the railway from Changchun to Dairen and Port Arthur were transferred to Japan. These transfers were subsequently confirmed by China, and in 1915 it was agreed that the lease should be extended to 99 years from the date of the original lease of the territory. That is to say, the term of this lease will expire in 1997. The terms of the South Manchuria Railway Company's lease of the Dairen-Changchun and Antung-Mukden lines were also extended to 99 years from the original date of lease, and the respective Railway Zones will remain under Japanese control until the years 2002 and 2007.

By the Sino-Japanese Treaty and Notes of 1915, Japan also obtained the rights for Japanese subjects to lease

pages.zh:
今日之满洲
日本管辖权

一般说明

如今，日本仅在称为关东州的租借地，以及由南满洲铁道经营的大连-新京（前长春）线和安东-奉天线的铁路沿线地区行使管辖权，也就是说，其范围与新国家建立之前完全相同。租借地和铁路沿线地区的总面积约为3,752平方公里或1,400平方英里。

从历史上看，包括旅顺和大连在内的关东州是辽东半岛领土的一部分。该半岛本身是指从鸭绿江口经凤凰城和海城至营口的连线以南的领土，面积约10,600平方英里，该地区曾于1895年通过《马关条约》割让给日本，但因德国和法国支持的俄国干涉而归还中国。三年后，关东州于1898年3月27日租给俄国，租期25年，经双方同意可延长，俄国修建了一条从哈尔滨到大连的铁路，作为中东铁路的一条支线。通过1905年的《朴茨茅斯条约》，关东州的租借权以及从长春到大连和旅顺的铁路转让给了日本。这些转让随后得到中国的确认，并于1915年达成协议，将该领土的租期从原始租期之日起延长至99年。也就是说，该租期将于1997年届满。南满洲铁道株式会社对大连-长春线和安东-奉天线的租期也从原始租期之日起延长至99年，各自的铁路沿线地区将分别在日本控制之下直至2002年和2007年。

通过1915年的《中日条约》及换文，日本还获得了日本臣民租赁的权利

1

pages.en:
land, to engage in coal-mining enterprises, and certain
other rights in Manchuria. China, however, sought the
abrogation of the treaties of 1915, at the Paris Peace
Conference in 1919, on the ground that they were imposed
by force. The Chinese claim, however, had small direct
concern with the purpose of the Conference, which was to
formulate the terms of a treaty of peace with Germany and
her allies, and it was, therefore, not taken into serious
consideration. A Chinese delegate at the Washington
Conference in 1921-2 again urged that "the Treaties and
Exchange of Notes of 1915" be "reconsidered and cancelled."
A Japanese delegate answered that "Japan has no intention
at present to relinquish the important rights of the lease-
holds which she has acquired lawfully and at no small
sacrifice," and that "the question of the validity of the
Treaty or Agreements of 1915, or the change or abrogation
thereof," is "one to be taken up between Japan and China,
if it were to be taken up at all, and not at this confer-
ence." Baron Shidehara, another Japanese delegate, also
stated that "if it should once be recognized that rights
solemnly granted by treaty may be revoked at any time on
the ground that they were conceded against the spontaneous
will of the grantor, an exceedingly dangerous precedent
will be established, with far-reaching consequences upon
the stability of the existing international relations in
Asia, in Europe, and everywhere."

Prior to the Manchurian Incident, the Chinese authori-
ties in Manchuria, impassioned by the "Rights Recovery"
mania, went to extremities in attempts to nullify existing
international agreements by means of legislative or local
administrative measures, and often by resort to illegal
action. These movements of the Chinese raised many issues,
particularly with the Japanese, of railway and residential
rights, leaseholds, unjust tariffs and taxation, and produc-
ed deplorable incidents, the last of which was the destruc-
tion of a part of the South Manchuria Railway near Mukden
on the night of September 18, 1931, by Chinese regular
soldiers, which constituted the direct cause of the recent
Sino-Japanese hostilities.

In the Manchoukuo Proclamation of Independence and the
Note of the Foreign Minister subsequently sent to foreign
powers, the new Government pledged their succession to
valid foreign obligations within the limits of the State
of Manchoukuo, and their intention faithfully to discharge

2
pages.zh:
土地，从事煤矿企业，以及在满洲的其他某些权利。然而，中国在1919年的巴黎和会上以这些条约是强加为由，寻求废除1915年的条约。然而，中国的诉求与和会的宗旨——即制定与德国及其盟友的和平条约条款——直接关系不大，因此未得到认真考虑。在1921-2年的华盛顿会议上，中国代表再次敦促“重新考虑并取消”“1915年的条约及换文”。一位日本代表回答说，“日本目前无意放弃其合法且付出巨大牺牲而获得的租借地的重要权利”，并且“1915年条约或协定的有效性问题，或其变更或废除问题”，“如果非要处理的话，应由日本和中国之间处理，而不是在此次会议上处理”。另一位日本代表币原喜重郎男爵（Baron Shidehara）也指出，“如果一旦承认庄严授予条约的权利可以因违背授予者自发意愿为由随时撤销，将建立一个极其危险的先例，对亚洲、欧洲及各地现有国际关系的稳定产生深远影响。”

在满洲事变之前，满洲的中国当局受“收回权利”狂热的驱使，试图通过立法或地方行政措施，并经常诉诸非法行动，来使现有的国际协定无效，甚至走向极端。中国人的这些举动引发了许多问题，特别是与日本人之间关于铁路和居住权、租借地、不公正的关税和税收等问题，并导致了令人痛惜的事件，其中最近的一起是1931年9月18日晚，中国正规军破坏了沈阳附近南满铁路的一部分，这构成了近期中日敌对行动的直接原因。

在《满洲国独立宣言》及随后发给外国列强的外交部长照会中，新政府承诺在满洲国国家范围内继承有效的外国义务，并打算忠实地履行

2

pages.en:
those obligations. Furthermore, the Manchoukuo Government
by the Manchoukuo-Japanese Protocol concluded on September
15, 1932, confirmed all rights and interests possessed
by Japan or her subjects within the territory of Manchou-
kuo by virtue of former Sino-Japanese treaties, agreements
or other arrangements or of Sino-Japanese contracts, private
as well as public. By this protocol, Japan assumed mili-
tary responsibility in co-operation with Manchoukuo for
maintaining peace and order in the territory of Manchoukuo
as well as for maintaining the security of the two nations.
After this protocol recognizing the Manchoukuo independence
was concluded, the Japanese Government established their
permanent Embassy at Hsinking, the capital of the new State,
on October 1, 1932.

Unification of the "Four-headed System"
in Japanese Jurisdiction

Prior to the establishment of the Japanese Embassy in
Hsinking, the Governor of Kwantung Province (Leased Terri-
tory), a civil appointee, exercised (1) administrative
and judicial jurisdiction in the Province, (2) control
of the police in the Leased Territory and the Railway Zone,
and (3) supervision of the business of the South Manchuria
Railway Company, while the Commander-in-Chief of the Kwan-
tung Army controlled the garrison troops and railway guards.
In addition to this, the Japanese consular authorities
exercised consular jurisdiction outside the Leased Terri-
tory in virtue of Japan's extraterritorial rights, and the
South Manchuria Railway, participating in local administra-
tion, conducted education, sanitation and public works
services within the Railway Zone.

Following the outbreak of the Manchurian Incident and
the subsequent establishment of Manchoukuo, it was felt
better to unify the direction of the different Japanese
jurisdictions in Manchuria in order to promote more effi-
ciency and harmony. This unification was also necessary
to maintain harmony with the Manchoukuo Government, special-
ly after Manchoukuo co-operated with Japan in maintaining
peace and order by the terms of the Protocol, and the
Japanese and Manchoukuo telegraph and telephone systems
were amalgamated and brought under the management of a
corporation called the Manchou Telegraph-Telephone Joint Co.
The idea of bringing all Japanese Government organs in

3
pages.zh:
这些义务。此外，满洲国政府通过1932年9月15日签订的《日满议定书》，确认了日本或其臣民依据以前的中日条约、协定或其他安排，以及中日公私合同，在满洲国领土内拥有的所有权利和利益。通过该议定书，日本承担了与满洲国合作维持满洲国领土内的和平与秩序以及维护两国安全的军事责任。在签订承认满洲国独立的这项议定书后，日本政府于1932年10月1日在新国家首都新京设立了常驻大使馆。

日本管辖权下“四头体制”的统一

在日本驻新京大使馆设立之前，关东州（租借地）总督（文职任命）行使（1）该州的行政和司法管辖权，（2）对租借地和铁路附属地警察的控制权，以及（3）对南满洲铁道株式会社业务的监督权，而关东军司令官则控制驻军部队和铁路护卫队。除此之外，日本领事当局凭借日本的治外法权，在租借地以外行使领事管辖权，而参与地方行政的南满洲铁道株式会社则在铁路附属地内开展教育、卫生和公共工程服务。

随着满洲事变的爆发及随后满洲国的建立，人们认为最好统一满洲不同日本管辖权的指挥，以提高效率和和谐。这种统一对于保持与满洲国政府的和谐也是必要的，特别是在满洲国根据议定书条款与日本合作维持和平与秩序，以及日本和满洲国的电报和电话系统合并并由一家名为“满洲电信电话株式会社”的公司管理之后。将所有在

3

pages.en:
Manchuria under one direction had been urged for some years
in Japan, and in the summer of 1932 the first steps toward
its realization were taken.

Lieut.-General Shigeru Honjo, having faithfully dis-
charged his duties as Commander-in-Chief of the Kwantung
Army, specially since the Manchurian outbreak of September
1931, was relieved in August, 1932 and promoted to the
post of Military Councillor in Japan. General Nobuyoshi
Muto succeeded him as Commander-in-Chief of the Kwantung
Army, and was concurrently appointed as Ambassador to
Manchoukuo and Governor of the Kwantung Leased Territory.
In choosing General Muto, a man of high personal character,
wide experience and great tact, the Japanese Government
expected him to be able to guide the smooth working of a
new machine bringing together the four groups of juris-
diction and their staffs. In discharging his duties as
Commander-in-Chief of the Kwantung Army, he was subjected
to the supervision of the Minister of War and the Chief
of the Military General Staff. When he exercised the
civil administration in Kwantung Province, including
police administration in the Railway Zone, as Governor of
Kwantung, he was responsible to the Minister of Overseas
Affairs in Japan. As Ambassador to Manchoukuo, he
administered foreign affairs and supervised the Japanese
consulates in Manchoukuo, acting upon instructions of the
Foreign Minister in Tokyo. The Organic Law of the Kwan-
tung Government and that of the Kwantung Army, however,
remained in force without any change. The local administ-
ration in the Railway Zone--education, sanitary and other
public works of the S.M.R.--was to be conducted as hither-
to by the Company.

Shortly after his inspection tour of the Japanese
military garrison and administrative offices in South
Manchuria, General Muto was taken seriously ill, and he
died on July 26, 1933 at Hsinking. One day before his
death was announced, the Imperial Court, in recognition
of his meritorious services to the State, had created
him a Baron and decorated him with the Grand Cordon of
the Rising Sun. His death was lamented not only in
Japan but also in Manchoukuo in which construction work
was in course of steady progress thanks to his sympathetic
assistance. Field Marshal Muto's service in Manchoukuo,
though its duration was less than a year, contributed
considerably to the suppression of banditry and to assist-

4
pages.zh:
满洲的日本政府机构置于统一指挥之下的想法在日本已提倡多年，并在1932年夏季采取了实现这一目标的第一步。

本庄繁中将自1931年9月满洲事变爆发以来，特别是作为关东军司令官忠实地履行了其职责，于1932年8月被免职并晋升为日本军事参议官。武藤信义将军继任关东军司令官，并同时被任命为驻满洲国大使和关东租借地总督。日本政府选择武藤将军这位个人品格高尚、经验丰富且极具手腕的人，期望他能够引导整合四个管辖群体及其职员的新机制顺利运行。在履行关东军司令官职责时，他受陆军大臣和参谋总长的监督。当他以关东总督身份行使包括铁路附属地警察行政在内的关东州民政时，他对日本拓务大臣负责。作为驻满洲国大使，他根据东京外务大臣的指示处理外交事务并监督满洲国的日本领事馆。然而，《关东厅官制》和《关东军司令部条例》仍然有效，没有任何改变。铁路附属地的地方行政——南满铁路的教育、卫生和其他公共工程——仍由公司像以往一样进行。

在对南满的日本驻军和行政办公室进行视察后不久，武藤将军病重，并于1933年7月26日在新京去世。在他死讯公布的前一天，皇室为表彰其对国家的功绩，封其为男爵，并授予其旭日大绶章。他的去世不仅在日本，也在满洲国引起哀悼，得益于他的同情援助，满洲国的建设工作正在稳步进展。武藤元帅在满洲国的服务虽然持续时间不到一年，但对镇压匪患和协助

4

pages.en:
ing the internal reforms of the new State. Indeed, the
term of office concluded on May 20, when he was in active
service practically out of the root of the menace from
outside of the Manchoukuo border. He was succeeded by
General Takashi Hishikari who was similarly appointed
Commander-in-Chief of the Kwantung Army, Governor of the
Kwantung Leased Territory and Ambassador to Manchoukuo.

The Kwantung Army

The Japanese garrison troops and railway guards in
the Kwantung Leased Territory and the Railway Zone were
originally commanded by the Governor-General who had
also control of the civil administration in these regions.
Since the Governor-General was replaced in 1919 by the
Governor of Kwantung, a civil appointee, the military
power formerly possessed by the Governor-General was
vested in the Commander-in-Chief of the Kwantung Army, a
post created by the Organic Law of the Kwantung Army
issued on April 11, 1919. The Commander-in-Chief who
was a direct appointee of His Majesty the Emperor and
who originally was to be a General or Lieut.-General of
the Japanese Army, was vested with the command of the
Japanese garrison and railway guards and empowered to
protect Japanese railways in Manchuria. With regard to
the military administration and personnel of the Kwan-
tung Army, the Commander-in-Chief was responsible to the
Minister of War, but he was responsible to the Chief of
the General Staff for the mobilization of troops. The
Commander-in-Chief was authorized, in compliance with the
request of the Governor of Kwantung, to despatch troops
necessitated for the preservation of peace and order in
the region under the Governor's jurisdiction and of the
Railway Zone, but he was empowered to take independent
action in a case of emergency in which there was no time
to receive the Governor's request, and he reported on such
action to the Minister of War and the Chief of the General
Staff.

Prior to the Manchurian Incident, the Kwantung Army
maintained one division of garrison troops and six batta-
lions or less of railway guards, and its annual expendi-
ture was about ¥16,000,000. Since the outbreak of Sep-
tember, 1931, the Japanese Treasury spent over ¥370,000,-
000 up to the end of the fiscal year, 1933--¥54,700,000

5
pages.zh:
新国家的内部改革做出了巨大贡献。事实上，他的任期于5月20日结束，当时他积极服役，实际上消除了来自满洲国边境外的威胁根源。继任者是菱刈隆将军，他同样被任命为关东军司令官、关东租借地总督和驻满洲国大使。

关东军

关东租借地和铁路附属地的日本驻军部队和铁路护卫队最初由总督指挥，总督也控制这些地区的民政。自从1919年总督被文职任命的关东州总督取代后，前总督拥有的军事权力被授予关东军司令官，该职位是根据1919年4月11日颁布的《关东军司令部条例》设立的。司令官是天皇陛下的直接任命人员，最初应由日本陆军上将或中将担任，被赋予指挥日本驻军和铁路护卫队的权力，并有权保护满洲的日本铁路。关于关东军的军事行政和人事，司令官对陆军大臣负责，但在部队动员方面对参谋总长负责。司令官有权应关东州总督的请求，派遣维持总督管辖区域和铁路附属地和平与秩序所需的部队，但在没有时间收到总督请求的紧急情况下，他有权采取独立行动，并就此类行动向陆军大臣和参谋总长报告。

在满洲事变之前，关东军维持一个师团的驻军部队和六个营或更少的铁路护卫队，其年度支出约为16,000,000日元。自1931年9月爆发以来，截至1933财政年度末，日本国库支出了超过370,000,000日元——1931年为54,700,000日元

5

pages.en:
in 1931, ¥177,500,000 in 1932 and ¥138,300,000 in 1933.
In virtue of the Manchoukuo-Japanese Protocol concluded
in September 1932, Japan fulfills the responsibility of
military co-operation by stationing Japanese troops in
any places in Manchuria which may be necessary for the
maintenance of peace and order or for the national
security. Furthermore, the Manchoukuo Government have
assigned to the South Manchuria Railway the operation
and management of their railways of 3,000 kilometres,
which require adequate railway guards.

Under such new conditions, the Kwantung Army has
to provide an increase of garrison army and railway
guards.

The Kwantung Government

As stated in the previous section, the Governor-
General of Kwantung Province was replaced by the
Governor of Kwangtung, a civilian official, in April,
1919. Baron Gonnohye Hayashi, who once served as Ambassa-
dor to Great Britain, was appointed as the first civilian
governor of Kwantung Province. But Cabinet changes in
Japan have often necessitated a change in the governorship,
so that nine governors have functioned during the past
fourteen years until Marshal Nobuyoshi Muto, the Commander-
in-Chief of the Kwantung Army and Ambassador to Manchoukuo,
was appointed also Governor of Kwantung Province in August,
1932. It should be noted that when the Commander-in-Chief
of the Kwantung Army acts as Governor of Kwantung it is in
a civil capacity, according to the Organic Law of the
Kwantung Government. The functions of the Governor and
the organization of the Kwantung Government which were pro-
vided for in the Organic Law of the Kwantung Government,
remain in force without any change.

The details of the government organization were fully
stated in the previous Report and the following diagram
shows the present organization of the Kwantung Government,
and the functions of the bureaux, sections and various
institutions maintained by it:-

6
pages.zh:
，1932年为177,500,000日元，1933年为138,300,000日元。根据1932年9月签订的《日满议定书》，日本通过在满洲任何维持和平与秩序或国家安全所需的地方驻扎日本军队来履行军事合作的责任。此外，满洲国政府已将3,000公里铁路的运营和管理权交给南满洲铁道株式会社，这需要充足的铁路护卫队。

在这种新条件下，关东军必须增加驻军和铁路护卫队。

关东厅

Japanese Police Administration

The Japanese police administration in South Manchuria was inaugurated when the region was under military occupation during and after the Russo-Japanese war. Simultaneously with the establishment of the government-general in July, 1906, in Kwantung Province, the police administration was limited to the Leased Territory and the Japanese Railway Zone, where the Governor-General was responsible for the protection of the South Manchuria Railway lines. A police director-general acted under the control of the Governor-General. In order to maintain communication and harmony between the Railway Zone authorities and Japanese consular officers outside the Railway Zone, the consular officials were appointed in January, 1908, as ex-officio the police authority of the government-general. During the European war, the need for more effective maintenance of peace and order in Manchuria being felt, gendarme officers of the

9

Army Corps acted ex-officio in important police posts.
When the Governor-General in 1919 was replaced by the civil
Governor of Kwantung, all important police officials again
became civil appointees. From then onwards, there were
three systems of police administration,--the police of the
Kwantung Government in the Japanese Leased Territory and
the Railway Zone, the gendarmes of the Kwantung Army, and
the police maintained by the Japanese consulates outside
the Railway Zone.

The necessity for uniform control of the different
police systems was felt and studied for some time, special-
ly after the Japanese Embassy was created in Manchoukuo.
The question of uniform control of the Japanese police
system in Manchuria has been finally settled and the
Embassy made an announcement on January 29, 1934, as follows:

The Japanese consular police in Manchuria have
been co-operating with the gendarmes and the police
of the Kwantung Government since the outbreak of
the Manchurian emergency, but in view of the pressure
of business, the Japanese Embassy has decided to
increase the consular police force, entrusting the
command of the consular police to the commander of
the gendarmes of the Kwantung Army, and engaging
the services of gendarmerie officers and officials
of the Kwantung Government as members of the staff
of the Japanese Embassy. By this change of the
system, closer co-operation will be maintained among
the consular police, the gendarmes and the police
of the Kwantung Government.

the Leased Territory. This regulation established a two-

日本法院

关于关东州的司法行政，日本最初决定不承认外国治外法权，遵循其他列强在中国本土租借地采用的惯例。根据1906年7月31日颁布的第198号帝国敕令，都督府法院（法院）在总督（1919年起为关东厅长官）的直接控制下成立，负责审理租借地内所有不分国籍的民事和刑事案件。该规定建立了二审制，后来修改为

three-trial system in vogue in Japan. The Courts of Justice
consist of a High Court and a Local Court. The High Court
is divided into the Cassation Department (Court of Cassation)
and Appeal Department (Appeal Court). In the beginning,
the administration of justice was based partly on the
Japanese Civil and Criminal Codes and partly on local laws
and usages, but since the judicature ordinance of the
Kwantung Province was issued in 1909, the laws of Japan
have been applied in general. Chinese usages, however, are
often observed in cases relating to the family, succession,
bankruptcy, criminal and other actions. While registration
matters are administered by the District (or lowest) Court
in Japan proper, these matters in the Leased Territory are
conducted by the local administrative offices.

Judicial cases within and outside the South Manchuria
Railway Zone are under consular jurisdiction in accordance
with the provisions regarding extraterritoriality of the
former Sino-Japanese Treaty. But appeal or cassation
cases come before the High Court in the Leased Territory,
except those cases originating in the Chientao District,
on the Korean border, which come before the High Court in
Keijo, Korea.

Since Manchoukuo has become an independent State,
the Government, though provisionally adopting the former
Chinese judicial system as well as civil and criminal laws,
have taken steps seriously to reform the judicial system
and jurisprudence in co-operation with Japanese advisers.
Should the Manchoukuo law courts and laws develop to a
stage commanding the confidence of civilized nations,
Japan will initiate the recognition of the judicial auto-
nomy of Manchoukuo by withdrawing her consular jurisdic-
tion.

the general wishes of business men at home and

and people be cultivated."

南满铁道的财务

该公司的法定资本原为2亿日元，其中相当于1亿日元的部分由日本政府提供，方式是将其根据《朴茨茅斯条约》从俄国接收的所有铁路、煤矿及其附属财产移交给该公司。另一半在公司于1906年成立时向中国政府及中日公众募集，但未获中方接受。随着其业务发展的必要需求，特别是在欧洲战争之后，公司于1920年将其资本从2亿日元增至4.4亿日元。政府通过承接公司在伦敦市场发行的三批债券，再次将其持股增加1.2亿日元，即新增资本的一半：400万英镑（利率5%）、200万英镑（利率5%）和600万英镑（利率4.5%），总计1200万英镑。在1933年3月6日举行的股东大会上，公司将资本从4.4亿日元增至8亿日元。政府也将其持股增加了新增资本的一半，另一半留给公众认购。

公司最初被授权发行相当于非政府持有人未缴股本金额的债券。根据1910年第4号帝国敕令，此金额可增至所有实缴股本总额的两倍，但不得超过法定资本额。

公司在第一阶段的财务政策是通过发行债券而非增发新股来为其项目筹集资金。鉴于伦敦是最有利的市场，在截至1911年1月3日的四年间，公司相继在伦敦发行了四批债券，总计1400万英镑。如前所述，其中1200万英镑的债券于1922年被政府承接，以支付其持有的股本；剩余的200万英镑债券在1933年催缴增资的第一期款项时再次被政府承接。自1917年以来，公司的债券主要在日本发行。截至1933年3月31日的过去二十六年间，债券发行总额达8.00434亿日元，其中已偿还4.10907亿日元，尚余3.89527亿日元未偿还。

The history and details of the Fushun coal-mines and the
Anshan iron-works were fully related in the former Report.

The Company is fortunate in operating a rich coal-
bed like that at Fushun, the largest open cut in the
world. The coal-bed covers an area of twenty-three
square miles and the deposits have been estimated at more
than 952,000,000 tons after a careful survey. About
92,000,000 tons have been mined during the last twenty-
six years, so that more than 860,000,000 tons of deposits
remain. Probably no similar deposit can be found any-
where in the world in such a relatively small area. The
Company also operates a coal-mine at Yentai, in which
are deposits estimated at 20,000,000 tons.

The annual output at the Fushun mine was about
6,500,000 tons prior to 1927. Mr. Jotaro Yamamoto, a former
president of S.M.R., initiated in 1928 a five year plan
as a third stage of mining development. With the comple-
tion of this scheme the annual output from the Fushun mine
is expected to be over 8,000,000 tons in the fiscal year
1933.

The iron works at Anshan, producing pig-iron by utilizing local ore of low percentage, was established in 1918. The total deposits in the Anshan vicinity have been estimated at about 400,000,000 tons. But as the ore is mostly poor, containing about 35% to 40% of iron, except a few ores of 50%, the so-called hematite reducing system and the magnetic concentration system, by which the percentage can be increased to 55 on an average, have been adopted. The Company invested up to 1926 ¥45,900,000 in this work. However, owing to the world-wide post-bellum depression, the loss on this enterprise has been continuous.

Mr. Yamamoto, who occupied the presidency of the Company from 1927 to 1929, adopted an optimistic policy on the basis that the annual production should be augmented, while minimizing expenditure as far as possible by cutting the price of coal supplied by the Company and reducing the salaries of the higher employees. On the other hand, the capital stock was reduced from ¥45,000,000 to ¥20,700,000. It was also decided to construct a larger up-to-date blast furnace capable of producing 500 tons per day, in addition to the two blast furnaces maintained before.

Mr. Yamamoto devised a plan in 1929 to set up a steel

MANCHURIA TODAY
FOREIGN TRADE

General Remarks

The trade of Manchuria, which maintained an unbroken
record of progress up to 1929, fell off in 1930 owing to the
world-wide depression, coupled with the ever-falling price
of silver which especially affected Far Eastern trade. The
trade figures for 1931 and 1932 showed a continued decrease
owing to the disturbance of communications occasioned by the
Manchurian Incident. However, in 1933, there was a remar-
kable increase, making a new record specially in import trade.
Peace and order having been gradually and steadily establish-
ed and the new Government's extensive reconstruction progra-
mme having been steadily carried into effect with Japanese
assistance, the trade of Manchoukuo has assumed a much bright-
er prospect. Indeed the new trade figures constitute a ma-
terial proof of the new Government's capable administration.

Reviewing the trade history of Manchuria, it can be
said that the Russo-Japanese war, which marked a new epoch
in the development of Manchuria, politically and economical-
ly, introduced a most radical change in the commercial
situation, especially after the opening of Dairen as a free
port by Japan. Prior to the Russo-Japanese war, Newchwang
was the only port in Manchuria opened to foreign trade.
Newchwang and Tientsin were opened at the same time, as
early as 1861, and each had a great hinterland of which it
was the outlet, but while the trade of Tientsin markedly
increased, maintaining a position next to Shanghai, that of
Newchwang advanced but slowly, the percentage of this port's
trade to China's total trade being less than ten for many
years. The position of Newchwang, indeed, handicapped its
trade. The port is situated several miles up the Liao
River, where the fairway is too narrow to admit of naviga-
tion by large steamers, and, what is worse, it is ice-
bound during four months in the year. It was the opening
of Dairen and other ports that brought about such a
stupendous growth of trade as has been experienced in
Manchuria. The harbour of Dairen, much favoured by nature,
naturally deep, well-sheltered, and free from ice all the
year round, was further improved at heavy expenditure; and,
as the most important gateway of the South Manchuria Rail-
way, the main line of which traverses the heart of South

对外贸易

总论

满洲的贸易在1929年之前一直保持持续增长的记录，但由于世界性经济萧条，加上银价不断下跌（这对远东贸易影响尤甚），1930年出现下滑。由于“九一八事变”导致交通中断，1931年和1932年的贸易数据显示持续下降。然而，1933年出现显著增长，进口贸易尤其创下新纪录。随着和平与秩序逐渐稳定确立，以及在新政府的广泛重建计划在日本协助下稳步实施，伪满洲国的贸易展现出更加光明的前景。的确，新的贸易数据构成了新政府有力行政管理的实质性证明。

回顾满洲的贸易史，可以说，标志着满洲政治和经济发展新纪元的日俄战争，给商业形势带来了最根本的变化，尤其是在日本将大连开辟为自由港之后。在日俄战争之前，营口是满洲唯一对外开放贸易的港口。营口和天津同时于1861年开埠，各自拥有广阔的腹地作为其出口通道，但是，虽然天津的贸易显著增长，保持着仅次于上海的地位，营口的贸易进展缓慢，该港口贸易占中国贸易总额的百分比多年来一直低于百分之十。事实上，营口的地位制约了其贸易发展。该港口位于辽河上游数英里处，航道太窄，大型轮船无法航行，更糟糕的是，每年有四个月冰封期。正是大连和其他港口的开放，带来了满洲所经历的如此巨大的贸易增长。大连港得天独厚，天然水深，遮蔽良好，全年不冻，并投入巨资进一步改善；作为南满洲铁道的主要门户，其主线贯穿南满中心地带，

The excess of imports in 1933 is due to steady purchases from Europe, America and Japan of material for constructive activities in Manchoukuo, particularly for building, railway and highway works.

In the above table, it will be seen that the most encouraging aspect of Manchuria's trade is the excess of exports over imports in most years, quite contrary to the trade in China proper, Japan, and Korea, whose imports invariably exceed exports. Manchuria has experienced an excess of imports only in those years marked by heavy purchases of rails, rolling stock, and machinery from America and Europe mostly by the South Manchuria Railway Company for the construction of railways and mines. While the new State stabilizes its construction work and the people gain more purchasing power under the new currency system, the excess of imports will probably continue.

Trade According to Countries

Japan's share of the foreign trade of Manchuria has been larger than that of any other nation for many years. Her share for 1933 was more than half of the total trade of Manchuria, which amounted to 937,867,000 yuan.

When Newchwang was the sole open port in Manchuria, its staple trade was the export of Manchurian beans and bean-cake to the southern provinces of China, where the bean-cake was extensively used as fertilizer for the sugar plantations. Beans were consumed in southern mills for oil extraction, the product being used as a substitute for groundnut oil. The imports at this port were cotton goods—of low grade—sheeting and drills—chiefly from England. Later on, American cheap sheeting and drills entered into competition with the English product. The trade with Japan was insignificant until after the Sino-Japanese war of 1894–5. Japan gradually became a heavy purchaser of Manchurian beans and beancake, and her purchases in 1898 equalled those of all the Chinese provinces. In 1903, the year before the Russo-Japanese war, Japanese purchases exceeded those of China proper, and ever since Japan has been the largest buyer of Manchurian bean products. European countries also became steady buyers of Manchurian beans after the war, the Mitsui firm of Japan having made a trial shipment to Liverpool in 1908.

按国别划分的贸易

多年来，日本在满洲对外贸易中的份额一直大于任何其他国家。1933年，日本的份额超过满洲贸易总额的一半，总额为937,867,000元。

当营口是满洲唯一的开放港口时，其主要贸易是向中国的南方省份出口满洲大豆和豆饼，豆饼在那里被广泛用作甘蔗种植园的肥料。大豆在南方的榨油厂中被消耗以提取豆油，该产品被用作花生油的替代品。该港口的进口货物主要是低等级的棉织品——平布和斜纹布——主要来自英国。后来，美国廉价平布和斜纹布进入市场，与英国产品竞争。直到1894-5年中日战争之后，对日贸易才变得重要起来。日本逐渐成为满洲大豆和豆饼的大买家，其1898年的采购量等于中国所有省份的采购量总和。1903年，即日俄战争的前一年，日本的采购量超过中国内地，从此日本一直是满洲豆类产品的最大买家。战后，欧洲国家也成为满洲大豆的稳定买家，日本的三井物产于1908年向利物浦试运了一批货物。

在日俄战争之前，日本产品对华出口增长极为缓慢。在棉织品方面——这历来是满洲进口项目中最大的一项——日本的份额几乎微不足道，而英美商品则占据主导地位。当时，日本初生的棉纺织业尚无力与英国、美国或印度的纱厂竞争。日本为发展该行业所付出的艰苦而持续的努力，特别是在日俄战争之后，逐渐取得了成功。此外，日本棉纺厂通过将高等级的美国原料与低等级的印度及中国原料混合，能够生产出成本低得多的标准纱线。再者，日本产品运抵满洲市场所需的运费要低得多。日本棉纺织业的这些天然优势，尤其是在中国市场，是美、英乃至印度的纱厂所无法抵消的。

在欧洲战争爆发之前，日本棉纺织业与其竞争对手的竞争已如此成功，以至于除最精细的种类外，几乎所有的棉织品均由日本供应。大战使西方国家的棉纺厂以及远洋运输陷入瘫痪，从而使日本在这一远东市场上获得了无可争议的霸权地位。如今，日本棉纺织业的组织程度极高，其产品几乎在世界任何地方都能成功竞争。但应当记住，日本向满洲或其他地方出口的棉织品越多，其从美国和印度购买的原料棉也就越多。

Trade According to Principal Commodities

As already stated, the most significant feature of
Manchurian trade in 1933 was the excess of imports over
exports contrary to previous years. The marked increase
of imports was due to the activity of the new Government
in construction work and the increase of purchasing
power of the people in general.

The exports of Manchuria are chiefly agricultural
produce, as is the case with Korea and Shantung Province,
China, although the export of mineral products, especial-
ly coal and iron, shows a tendency to increase. Beans
and their products, beancake and bean-oil, today command
the world's markets. For many years these exports have
constituted more than half of the total exports of Man-
churia. The total exports in 1933 amounted in value to
423,326,000 yuan, of which 241,000,000 yuan, or over
56 per cent. of the amount, represented the value of
beans, beancake and bean-oil. Japan became the heaviest
purchaser of these products after the Sino-Japanese war.
Since the Mitsui firm made the first considerable trial
shipment to England in 1908, the consumption of Manchu-
rian beans and bean-oil has increased in European countries
and to some extent in America. Great Britain, Netherlands,
Italy, Germany, France, Denmark, and other purchasers
consume in the aggregate as much as Japan. But while
Europe has bought more beans, more beancake is exported to
Japan. Of the agricultural products, the export next in
importance to beans is millet. For 1933 this trade, which
was chiefly with Korea, was valued at as much as 14,745,000
yuan. Of the export of kaoliang, valued in 1933 at 6,948,-
000 yuan, about half of it in value went to China proper.
With regard to mineral products, the export value of coal
was 47,379,000 yuan, about half of which went to Japan
proper, Korea and Formosa, and the rest to China, the
Philippines and other countries. The exports of pig-iron,
scrap-iron and other iron were valued at 10,546,000 yuan;
of which Japan purchased more than 78 per cent.

如前所述，1933年满洲贸易最显著的特征是与往年相反，进口超过出口。进口的大幅增加是由于新政府在建设工程方面的活跃以及人民整体购买力的提高。

满洲的出口主要是农产品，这与朝鲜和中国山东省的情况相同，尽管矿产品（特别是煤和铁）的出口呈现增长趋势。大豆及其制品豆饼和豆油如今主导着世界市场。多年来，这些出口品占满洲出口总额的一半以上。1933年的出口总值为423,326,000元，其中241,000,000元（即超过总额的56%）代表大豆、豆饼和豆油的价值。中日战争后，日本成为这些产品的最大买家。自从三井洋行于1908年首次向英国进行大规模试运以来，满洲大豆和豆油在欧洲国家的消费量有所增加，在美国也有一定程度的增长。英国、荷兰、意大利、德国、法国、丹麦和其他买家的总消费量与日本相当。但是，虽然欧洲购买了更多的大豆，但更多的豆饼出口到了日本。在农产品中，出口重要性仅次于大豆的是小米。1933年，这项主要面向朝鲜的贸易价值高达14,745,000元。高粱出口在1933年价值6,948,000元，其中约一半的价值流向了中国内地。就矿产品而言，煤炭的出口价值为47,379,000元，其中约一半输往日本本土、朝鲜和台湾，其余输往中国、菲律宾和其他国家。生铁、废铁及其他铁的出口价值为10,546,000元；其中日本购买了超过78%。

Shipping in the principal Manchurian ports, Dairen,

General Features

Many parts of the vast territory of Manchuria are
favoured with rich soil, the development of which, how-
ever, was neglected for many decades. The fame of Man-
churia was established in the political and diplomatic
sense in connection with the Sino-Japanese war, Russian
railway penetration and the Russo-Japanese War. But
its agricultural destiny was not generally realized until
the South Manchuria Railway, running through the valley
of the Liao River, brought large supplies of Manchurian
beans to Dairen, whence they were shipped to the markets
of Europe. Japan purchased a greater proportion of the
agricultural produce of Manchuria than China proper, or
any Western country, after the Sino-Japanese War. Indeed,
Manchurian produce today constitutes an important part
of the national foodstuffs of Japan and of the raw material
for her industries.

Under these conditions, the Chinese farmers should
have enjoyed a high degree of prosperity; but the fact is
that they suffered heavily under the military autocracy
of the Chang family, who not only neglected to develop
the country but had recourse to the issue of worthless
paper money and forced farmers to accept this in exchange
for their products, the fruit of their labour.

The new Government of Manchoukuo are encouraging
agricultural improvement by developing extensive transpor-
tation facilities and by reforming the chaotic currency,
both of which, it is hoped, will enable the farmers to
recover their prosperity. The ten year economic reconstruc-
tion programme formulated by the Government on March 1,
1933, states that inasmuch as "agriculture is the mainstay

概况

满洲辽阔领土的许多地区拥有肥沃的土壤，但其开发却在数十年间被忽视。满洲的名声是在政治和外交意义上，随着中日战争、俄国铁路渗透以及日俄战争而确立的。但是，直到贯穿辽河流域的南满洲铁道将大量满洲豆类运至大连，并从那里装运到欧洲市场，其农业命运才为世人所普遍认识。中日战争后，日本购买的满洲农产品比例超过中国内地或任何西方国家。事实上，如今满洲农产品构成了日本国民食品的重要部分及其工业原料。

在这种情况下，中国农民本应享有高度的繁荣；但事实是，他们在张氏家族的军事独裁统治下遭受了沉重打击，该家族不仅忽视了国家发展，还诉诸发行毫无价值的纸币，并强迫农民用他们的劳动成果——农产品来接受这些纸币。

满洲国新政府正通过发展广泛的交通设施和改革混乱的货币来鼓励农业改良，希望这两项措施能使农民恢复繁荣。政府于1933年3月1日制定的十年经济复兴计划指出，鉴于“农业是

This ten year programme also provides for exploitation of mines and forests and development of industry and declares that the present total production of the country, amounting to 3,000,000,000 yuan, will be doubled in less than ten years.

Agricultural Resources

The extensive area of arable land in Manchuria is the most important resource for agricultural development. In the five provinces of Manchoukuo the cultivated area is estimated at about 37,000,000 acres, and more than the same amount is awaiting cultivation. The greater part of the arable land in Heilungkiang, Kirin and Fengtien Provinces is fertile. On the other hand, many parts of the land in Hsingan and Jehol Provinces contain more alkali. The greater part of Heilungkiang Province and the northern part of Kirin Province have generally rich soil and are largely virgin. As these regions are sparsely populated, there is plenty of room for immigrants. According to the ten year economic reconstruction programme, the Government are contemplating river improvements and irrigation work to protect cultivated land and to render waste land suitable for cultivation. With the land and cadastral survey work completed, land ownership will be established, and thereby the evils which attend the unscrupulous annexation of land will be prevented. The Government are also contemplating special arrangements for the cultivation of untilled land, and within fifteen years about 12,500,000 acres (or 5,000,000 cho) of it will be developed by agricultural settlers. 农业资源

满洲广阔的耕地面积是农业发展最重要的资源。在满洲国五省中，耕地面积估计约为37,000,000英亩，另有超过同等数量的土地等待开垦。黑龙江、吉林和奉天省的大部分耕地都很肥沃。另一方面，兴安省和热河省的许多土地含有较多的碱分。黑龙江省大部分地区和吉林省北部通常土壤肥沃，且多为处女地。由于这些地区人口稀少，移民有充足的空间。根据十年经济复兴计划，政府正考虑进行河流整治和灌溉工程，以保护耕地并使荒地适合耕种。随着土地和地籍测量工作的完成，土地所有权将得以确立，从而防止伴随无耻兼并土地而来的弊端。政府还正在考虑为未耕地的开垦做出特殊安排，并在十五年内由农业移民开发约12,500,000英亩（或5,000,000町步）的土地。下表显示了耕地的分布及其开垦程度：

More than 3,000,000 families in Manchoukuo are engaged in agriculture. The former Chinese settlers, now Manchoukuo subjects, are most capable farmers, especially in upland cultivation, while Korean immigrants are ideal cultivators of paddy-fields. The Mongols, who predominate in Hsingan Province and in a part of Jehol Province, are ideal live-stock raisers. Japanese farming settlers, possessed of skilled labour and capital, have now full opportunities for participating in agricultural development in Manchuria, as the door is open to them under the present regime, which recognized the Japanese treaty right of leasing land by the Japanese-Manchoukuo Protocol signed in September, 1932 and the Provisional Registration Law promulgated on June 14, 1933. As the Manchoukuo Government are encouraging the immigration of qualified persons, the farming population in Manchuria, Chinese, Japanese and Koreans, should increase considerably in future.

Agricultural Produce

The principal agricultural products of Manchuria are the world-known soya bean and kaoliang, the staple food of the native. These two are followed by millet, maize (Indian corn), wheat, barley and rice. Among other products are hemp, flax, ramie, tobacco, cotton and wild silk cocoons. Cattle, horses, donkeys, mules, sheep, goats and hogs are the most important live-stock.

农产品

满洲的主要农产品是世界闻名的大豆和高粱，后者是当地人的主食。紧随其后的是小米、玉米（印第安玉米）、小麦、大麦和水稻。其他产品包括大麻、亚麻、苎麻、烟草、棉花和野蚕茧。牛、马、驴、骡、羊、山羊和猪是最重要的牲畜。

Soya Beans

The story of the Manchurian bean which today not only
commands a world market but constitutes a part of the
Japanese national food supply and important raw materials
for her industry is a striking romance in economic history.-
The Japanese, though naturally regretting the loss of
Liaotung, the "legitimate fruit" of the Sino-Japanese war,
found some compensation in the discovery of the Manchurian
bean which revolutionized the fertilizer industry and
became a substitute in the Japanese rice-fields for the
dry-herring fertilizer then extensively used. Ever since,
the Japanese have been the heaviest purchasers of the
Manchurian bean. The demand in Europe for soya beans is
considerable. The first trial shipment was made in 1908
by the Mitsui firm of Japan, being sent from Dairen to
Liverpool, and this was the beginning of a new industry
in England, Germany, Denmark and Holland. The major
portion of the beans destined for Europe was for the
mills at Liverpool and Hull, England; at Copenhagen,
Denmark; and at Rotterdam and Amsterdam, Holland.
Germany's consumption subsequently became greater than
all, and this, though interrupted during the European
war, is recovering. At the time of the universal short-
age of food during the Great War, the Manchurian bean also
played a very important part in the world's food supply.

The demand for the Manchurian bean is ever-increasing.
Beans and bean-cake imported by Japan, as foodstuff or
fertilizer, are today helping in the solution of the
national food problem. In England, Germany, Holland, and
Denmark, the bean oil is extracted and used in manufactur-
ing margarine, soap, etc., while the residue is extensive-
ly used as feed for live-stock. Beans can be grown in
the central and northern parts of the temperate zone, in
which lie North America, the northern part of Japan, Korea,
and North China. That the Manchurian beans have come to
occupy such an enviable position is due entirely to the
suitability of Manchuria for bean cultivation, in regard
to both climate and soil, and to the abundant supply of

大豆

满洲大豆的故事在经济史上是一段引人注目的传奇，它如今不仅占据世界市场，还构成了日本国民食品供应的一部分及其工业的重要原材料。日本人虽然对失去辽东——这一中日战争的“合法果实”——感到自然的遗憾，但在发现满洲大豆中找到了一些补偿，这场发现彻底改变了肥料行业，并成为日本稻田中当时广泛使用的干鲱鱼肥料的替代品。从此，日本人一直是满洲大豆的最大买家。欧洲对大豆的需求相当大。1908年，日本的三井物产进行了首次试运，从大连运往利物浦，这标志着英国、德国、丹麦和荷兰一个新行业的开端。运往欧洲的大部分大豆被送往英国的利物浦和赫尔、丹麦的哥本哈根以及荷兰的鹿特丹和阿姆斯特丹的磨坊。随后德国的消费量超过了所有其他国家，尽管在欧洲大战期间中断，但目前正在恢复。在第一次世界大战期间全球粮食短缺时，满洲大豆也在世界粮食供应中发挥了非常重要的作用。

对满洲大豆的需求日益增长。日本作为食品或肥料进口的大豆和豆饼，如今正有助于解决其国家粮食问题。在英国、德国、荷兰和丹麦，豆油被提取出来用于制造人造黄油、肥皂等，而残渣则广泛用作牲畜饲料。大豆可以在温带地区的中部和北部种植，北美、日本北部、朝鲜和华北均位于此区域。满洲大豆之所以能占据如此令人羡慕的地位，完全归功于满洲在气候和土壤方面适合大豆种植，以及该地区

acre in Manchuria is 20.4 bushels, while it is 16.6 bushels
in Japan, 13.2 in the United States, 10.5 in Korea, and
15.8 in China proper. The aggregate return of the world's
annual production was estimated in 1930 at 351,000,000
bushels, of which Manchurian produce amounted to
208,000,000 bushels, or 59 per cent. of the total. While
bean production in other parts of the world is more or
less stationary, production in Manchuria is increasing
every year.

Kaoliang, Millet, etc.

Kaoliang, millet and maize are the chief foodstuffs
of the inhabitants of Manchoukuo. Kaoliang, or sorghum,
being not only the staple food of the native population
but the principal grain food of numerous animals engaged
in farm work, the major portion of the cultivated land
of Manchuria has been devoted for centuries to the cultivation
of this grain, and its production, until fifteen years
ago, surpassed even that of the celebrated Manchurian
bean. But the tremendous growth of demand for beans in
the world market caused bean cultivation gradually to
encroach on the premier position held by kaoliang, and
today the land for kaoliang cultivation has been reduced
to about half of that for beans. Less than ten per cent.
of the annual production of kaoliang is sold outside
Manchuria. The export of this product in 1933 amounted
to about 6,136,363 piculs, 60 per cent. of which went
to China proper and 40 per cent. to Japan and other
countries. This cereal is largely used in China for
foodstuffs, spirit distilling, and cattle-feed. There
is a growing importation of kaoliang into Japan, where
it is used as raw material for foodstuff manufacture,
especially cornstarch, and as live-stock feed.

Next to kaoliang, millet is now the most important
crop, producing 3,144,000 metric tons or 128,305,142
bushels, every year, of which about 2,803,882 piculs were
exported in 1933, almost entirely to Korea. Korea,
notwithstanding a deficient rice supply, exports rice
to Japan proper to the amount of 21,000,000 bushels, and
imports Manchurian millet and the cheaper grade of Indo-

高粱、小米等

高粱、小米和玉米是满洲国居民的主要食物。高粱不仅是本地人口的主食，也是众多从事农作的动物的主要谷物饲料，因此几个世纪以来，满洲的大部分耕地都用于种植这种谷物，直到十五年前，其产量甚至超过了著名的满洲大豆。但是，世界市场对大豆需求的巨大增长导致大豆种植逐渐侵蚀了高粱的首要地位，如今高粱的种植面积已减少到大豆种植面积的一半左右。高粱年产量的不到百分之十在满洲以外销售。1933年该产品的出口量约为6,136,363担，其中60%运往中国内地，40%运往日本和其他国家。这种谷物在中国大量用于食品、酿酒和牛饲料。日本对高粱的进口量日益增长，在那里它被用作食品制造的原料，特别是玉米淀粉，以及作为牲畜饲料。

仅次于高粱，小米现在是第二重要的作物，每年产量为314.4万公吨或1.28305142亿蒲式耳，其中1933年出口了约2,803,882担，几乎全部运往朝鲜。尽管朝鲜大米供应不足，但仍向日本内地出口2,100万蒲式耳大米，并进口满洲小米和较便宜的印度支那

Wheat

Manchuria produces about 60,000,000 bushels of wheat
but imports foreign wheat or flour to the same amount or
more. The prospects for wheat raising are very promising,
particularly in North Manchuria where the soil and climatic
conditions are more favourable. By the ten year programme
of economic reconstruction, the Government expect to
increase the area of wheat cultivation to 2,300,000 cho
(47,500,000 acres) and the annual production of this grain
to 20,000,000 koku (400,000,000 bushel). Indeed, wheat
cultivation which can be carried on in zones as high as
Latitude 60°has a better prospect in Manchuria than cotton
or rice cultivation which requires a much more temperate
zone.

Staple Products for Industrial Raw Material

Manchuria produces hemp, wild silk, cotton, tobacco
and other raw materials of manufacturing industry. Culti-
vation of sugar-beet and hops is also promising. The
growing of these staple products will also be encouraged
by the Government "for the betterment of agricultural
enterprises and the prosperity of the farmers," as pro-
vided in the ten year programme of economic reconstruction.

With regard to cotton, the ten year programme states:

"The area for the cultivation cotton will be increased
to 300,000 cho, (cho=2.45 acres) and the annual output
of ginned cotton to 150,000,000 kin (kin=1.33 pounds).

The world cotton cultivation zone is generally
understood to be below Latitude 37°. Manchuria lies above
this zone, yet the southern part of Manchuria today produces
about 32,000,000 pounds of cotton. The districts along

小麦

满洲生产约6,000万蒲式耳小麦，但进口同等数量或更多的外国小麦或面粉。小麦种植的前景非常广阔，特别是在北满，那里的土壤和气候条件更为有利。根据十年经济复兴计划，政府期望将小麦种植面积增加到230万町步（4,750万英亩），并将该谷物的年产量增加到2,000万石（4亿蒲式耳）。事实上，可在高达北纬60度的地带进行的小麦种植，在满洲比需要更温和地带的棉花或水稻种植具有更好的前景。

工业原材料的主要产品

满洲生产大麻、野蚕丝、棉花、烟草和其他制造业工业原材料。甜菜和啤酒花的种植也颇有前景。正如十年经济复兴计划所规定，政府也将鼓励种植这些主要产品，“以改善农业企业和促进农民繁荣”。

关于棉花，十年计划指出：

“棉花种植面积将增加到30万町步（1町步=2.45英亩），皮棉年产量将达到1.5亿斤（1斤=1.33磅）。

世界棉花种植带通常被认为在北纬37度以下。满洲位于此带以北，但如今满洲南部生产约3,200万磅棉花。沿

Wild cocoon culture for making Tussah, the wild silk
peculiar to South Manchuria, is rather promising. The
southern part of Fengtien Province, in particular, the
so-called Liaotung Peninsula, is noted as the most flourish-
ing centre of this industry, Antung and Kaiping being the

Live-Stock

As stated in previous Reports, the Manchurian and
Mongolian natives being originally hunting tribes, their
chief industry was live-stock farming, specially horse
breeding. With the entry of the Chinese, the rich pastoral
lands were gradually put under the plough, particularly
in South Manchuria. Yet, today, a shadow of the old
pastoral age is visible in Hsingan and Jehol Provinces,
where the inhabitants are still devoted to cattle breeding.
Chinese farming settlers in Manchuria, moreover, generally
keep a number of oxen, horses, mules and donkeys for breed-
ing, farming and transport. Sheep and pigs are also
extensively raised in Manchuria and Inner Mongolia.

The total live-stock in Manchoukuo at present is
estimated at about 20,000,000 heads--cattle 2,700,000,
horses 3,600,000, sheep 4,900,000, swine 9,800,000. As
the native live-stock, however, is of inferior breed,
which lowers its value as an economic resource, the
ten year programme of economic reconstruction provides the
following measures for its improvement:

1. "The existing breed of horses will be improved
upon by introducing Arabs and Anglo-Arabs and other su-
perior strains, as a result of which at least 2,000,000
select heads are to be obtained.

用于制造柞蚕丝（一种南满特有的野蚕丝）的野蚕养殖业相当有前景。奉天省南部，特别是所谓的辽东半岛，被誉为该行业最繁荣的中心，安东和盖平是主要的集散市场。关于野蚕茧产量没有可靠的统计数据。奉天和吉林省的年产量估计在80亿至100亿个茧之间，价值约2,500万日元。仅1933年出口的野生生丝价值就达9,471,000日元。

牲畜

如前几份报告所述，满洲和蒙古原住民原本是狩猎部落，其主要产业是畜牧业，特别是养马。随着汉人的进入，肥沃的牧场逐渐被开垦耕种，特别是在南满。然而，如今在兴安省和热河省仍可见旧游牧时代的影子，那里的居民仍致力于养牛。此外，满洲的中国农耕移民通常饲养一定数量的牛、马、骡子和驴，用于繁殖、耕作和运输。绵羊和猪在满洲和内蒙古也广泛饲养。

目前满洲国的牲畜总数估计约为2,000万头——牛270万头，马360万头，羊490万头，猪980万头。然而，由于本地牲畜品种较差，降低了其作为经济资源的价值，十年经济复兴计划规定了以下改进措施：

1. “将通过引进阿拉伯马、英阿杂交马和其他优良品种来改良现有马种，由此至少获得200万头精选良驹。

Model Farms

Farming methods in Manchuria changed little during
many centuries. The native farmers are slow in select-
ing better soils or seedlings, improving the method of
manuring, breeding improved cattle or reclaiming virgin
lands.

Since the Japanese advent in Manchuria, most
energetic steps have been taken to improve agriculture
by the establishment of model farms, live-stock breed-
ing stations and seedling nurseries in the Railway Zone
and the Leased Territory. These undertakings for wider
distribution of improved seeds and seedlings and
advanced breeding, conducted by the S. M. R. and the
Kwantung Government, were fully treated in the previous
Reports. This stimulated the Chinese in some degree even
under the former regime, and agricultural experimental

Kirin and Tsitsihar, where provincial governments are
located. Chinese schools of agriculture were also
established in Mukden and Kirin, in addition to a
botanical garden and seedling station in Mukden. But
most of these organizations were left in a neglected

模范农场

满洲的耕作方法在许多世纪中变化甚微。当地农民在选择更优良的土壤或种苗、改进施肥方法、繁育改良牲畜或开垦荒地方面进展缓慢。
